name: Notion
description: Notion skills and MCP server for documents, research, meetings, and tasks.

setup.title: Connect Notion
setup.description: Notion registers OpenTeam during OAuth, so there are no secrets to create.
steps: Choose the workspace and pages OpenTeam may access.
Return to OpenTeam after authorization completes.

skills.name: search
skills.description: Search Notion across pages and databases, including paginated results and source links.

skills.name: find
skills.description: Locate a specific Notion page or database by title, URL, or identifying context.

skills.name: create-page
skills.description: Create and verify a Notion page in the intended parent with an appropriate document structure.

skills.name: create-task
skills.description: Add a task to an existing Notion task database with validated status, dates, owner and project.

skills.name: create-database-row
skills.description: Insert a Notion database row by mapping natural-language values to its actual property schema.

skills.name: database-query
skills.description: Query a Notion data source with typed filters, sorting, pagination and readable results.

skills.name: knowledge-capture
skills.description: Turn a discussion into linked Notion documentation with decisions, rationale and unresolved questions.

skills.name: meeting-intelligence
skills.description: Prepare a meeting pre-read and agenda from relevant Notion context and authorized connected sources.

skills.name: research-documentation
skills.description: Research a topic across Notion and save a sourced synthesis with uncertainty and recommendations.

skills.name: spec-to-implementation
skills.description: Convert a Notion specification into an implementation plan and linked, verifiable tasks.

skills.name: tasks-plan
skills.description: Create an actionable implementation plan from a Notion task or specification.

skills.name: tasks-build
skills.description: Implement an authorized Notion task and update its progress with evidence from the work.

skills.name: tasks-explain-diff
skills.description: Create a Notion document explaining a concrete code diff, its behavior and verification.

skills.name: tasks-setup
skills.description: Set up or connect a Notion task board with a usable schema and verified sample workflow.
